A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show that the structure of the tournament class associated with a parametric tournament representation is determined by its smallest flip class.

we show that the class of parametric tournament representations is rich enough to capture all tournaments, but not so rich to capture all possible tournament representations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the parametric representation models are able to capture the structure of intransitive tournaments, and that this structure is intimately connected to the feedback arc set problem.
